inputs.prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Orthographic photograph, taken straight on, of board marked cast concrete, 2400 mm across, weathered by years of city street rain: grey rain streaking, small blowholes, patches of pale laitance, fine shrinkage cracking, dirt held in the board grain, regular formwork tie holes. Flat even overcast light with no shadows, no highlights and no vignetting. The whole frame is the surface: no windows, no doors, no signs, no text, no people, no sky, no horizon.

reasons.components.base: Qwen-Image-2512, Apache-2.0 at a pinned revision, accepted 2026-09-17 (licence matrix section 12)
reasons.components.control: the Fun union control trained for Qwen-Image-2512 (the 2602 release), Apache-2.0; the InstantX union control was trained for the original Qwen-Image
reasons.conditioning.depth: the set's own height map: the recipe's exact panel seams, board grain and blowholes; encoding: the recipe's exact height map as grey, raised relief white, which is the near-is-white convention depth controls were trained on
reasons.container: the image this lane built from its committed recipe, pinned by digest
reasons.guardrails: these models ship no guardrail, and their only inputs are a committed texture set's own relief and a prompt written from the catalog, with no people and nothing personal
reasons.inputs: the recipe's own words for what it painted, weathered. The 2 mm panel seams the recipe states are NOT named: at 2400 mm across a 1024 px tile they are 0.85 px wide and do not appear in the structure the model is given, so asking for them would ask the model to invent structure this lane says comes from the record
reasons.sampler.control_context_scale_milli: 0.80, VideoX-Fun's example value, inside the 0.70 to 0.95 range the control's card recommends for stronger control and detail
reasons.sampler.guidance_milli: 4.0, the true classifier-free guidance VideoX-Fun's Qwen control example uses
reasons.sampler.name: the flow-match Euler scheduler the base repository ships and VideoX-Fun's own example selects
reasons.sampler.negative_prompt: a single space, which is what enables true classifier-free guidance in this pipeline without describing anything
reasons.sampler.steps: 50, the step count VideoX-Fun's Qwen control example uses
reasons.sampler.tiling: the lane's tiling schedule: the latent grid and the control latents are rolled by a seeded offset each step and rolled back, because a transformer model has no convolution padding to make periodic
reasons.sampler.width: 1024, the published sets' own width, so the output needs no resampling to become a set
reasons.sampler.wrap_margin_px: 64 px, eight latent pixels of the neighbouring tile given to the VAE on each side and cropped after, so its convolutions see the tile's other edge instead of zeros
reasons.seed: seed index 2 of 4 by the job's seed rule: the first four bytes, big-endian, of sha256 of 'exulanica.appearance-seed/v1:<job>:<target>:<candidate>:<role>:<index>'

regeneration: GPU generation is not bit-exact across hardware, drivers or library versions. These output bytes are the artifact. Running this record again makes a new version with new digests; it is never a replay.
